capabilities: Renders h5-renderer fenced HTML blocks as themed cards
Strips scripts and remote resources for zero-network rendering
Toggles blocks between card and source view
Degrades slow-rendering blocks back to source
Inserts sample notes and AI prompt instructions
disambiguation: Not a general HTML previewer or page builder; it recognizes only the h5-renderer fence and renders sanitized static HTML, never scripts or remote resources.
extras: Desktop-only per manifest, flag expected to flip after mobile testing; requires Obsidian 1.12.7+; no telemetry or network access; exactly four settings.
problem: Obsidian shows pasted AI-written HTML as a plain code block, with no way to see it as a card that matches the note's look.
summary: Renders h5-renderer fenced HTML blocks as static visual cards that inherit the note's theme, width and typography in editing and reading views.
